items.label: Finish every B-Side first
items.note: C-Sides unlock after 8B, which itself requires completing all the other B-Sides.

items.label: Clear all eight C-Sides
items.note: Three to four rooms each, no checkpoints, ending in a Yellow Crystal Heart. Earns Thanks For Playing.

items.label: Open Core C-Side's 23-heart door
items.note: Core's C-Side sits behind a Heart Door needing 23 crystal hearts, and the other seven C-Sides open the Crystal Heart Gate inside it. Completing it unlocks Variant Mode.
